Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ProducerRange_: How far from a building's outline, in tiles, a generator or water tank can be connected to its utility panel.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ExteriorRange_: How far from a building's outline, in tiles, a device outside any building can be connected to its utility panel.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_SubPanelRange_: How far apart, in tiles, two buildings can be for one's utility panel to take supply from the other's.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_CostsEnabled_t: Connecting a generator, a water tank, an outside device or a sub-panel takes tools and wire or pipe by length.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_TilesPerPiece_: How many tiles of line one wire or one pipe makes.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RefundPercent_: The percent of a line's wire and pipe given back when it is taken away.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_OverloadEnable: A utility panel whose load is over what its tier carries cuts its power until a player resets it.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_Capacity1_tool: A fridge and freezer draw 0.13, a stove 0.09, a washer 0.09, a light 0.002.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_LowFuelHours_t: Players near a utility panel are told when its generators have fuel for fewer hours than this.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_ExperienceMult: Multiplies the Electricity experience for putting up boxes, laying wire and upgrading boxes. 0 gives none.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_RangePerTier_t: Each utility panel tier above the first adds this share of the ranges above (50: tier 2 reaches 1.5 times, tier 3 twice, tier 4 2.5 times as far). Outside devices stay within 32 tiles.
Sandbox_BuildingUtilities_LossPerWire_to: The power line into a tier 1 utility panel, from its generator or its main panel, adds this much of the load per wire it took (the generator burns it and it counts toward overload). Tier 2 loses two thirds of that, tier 3 one third, tier 4 nothing. 0 turns losses off.
